summary.short: Hungarian implementing act for the EU AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689). Designates the notifying and market surveillance authorities, sets their powers and procedures and fine powers, creates the Hungarian AI Council and an AI regulatory sandbox. Most provisions take effect 31 days after promulgation; sec. 3(2) and sec. 10 from 2 August 2026.
summary.long: The Act provides the national framework for applying Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 in Hungary. Under sec. 3 the Government designates by decree a notifying authority and a market surveillance authority, and the market surveillance authority also operates the single point of contact. Sec. 4 governs the assessment, designation, notification and monitoring of conformity assessment bodies for high-risk AI systems, applying Act CXXXIII of 2009 with the stated deviations. Sec. 5 sets the market surveillance authority's general competence and its exclusive competence in certain proceedings, and sec. 5(4)-(5) provide for sector authorities' participation. Sec. 6 excludes summary proceedings and allows suspension in listed cases. Sec. 7 lists the authority's decision powers, including administrative fines, establishing unlawful use of an AI system and ordering cessation or restoration, and allows it to require data from providers and prospective providers and to carry out unannounced inspections and tests in real-world conditions. Sec. 8 establishes the Hungarian AI Council, a body without decision-making powers that issues recommendations and guidelines and coordinates national activities, and sec. 9 sets its membership and meeting rules. Sec. 10 requires the market surveillance authority to establish and operate an AI regulatory sandbox, with rules set by ministerial decree. Sec. 11 authorises the Government and the minister to issue implementing decrees. Sec. 12 sets entry into force 31 days after promulgation, with sec. 3(2) and sec. 10 applying from 2 August 2026.

thresholds.note: The text contains no numeric cutoff that changes legal treatment. Numbers present are regulation numbers (e.g., 2024. június 13-i (EU) 2024/1689), the 5-year term of the Council chair (9. § (2)), the 31st-day entry-into-force rule (12. § (1)), the 2026. augusztus 2 date (12. § (2)), and the quarterly meeting rule (9. § (6)). None sets scope, eligibility, exemption, obligation tier, prohibition, benefit, penalty tier or price tier. Penalty amounts are not stated (7. § (1) a) refers to közigazgatási bírság with the amount left to government decree under 11. § (2) c)). Government decrees under 11. § (2) are delegations but set no threshold stated in this text.
